# ISM Ministers' Prayer Network

> A global prayer network for pastors, ministers and evangelists — live prayer groups, prayer requests, weekly prayer points, live services and ministry resources.

ISM Ministers' Prayer Network unites ministers across 195+ nations in consistent intercession, offering live video prayer rooms, weekly prayer bulletins, ministry programmes, a bookstore for ministers, and partnership opportunities.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the prayer network, featured books and programmes.
- [About](/about): Mission, vision and story of the network.
- [Prayer Requests](/prayer-requests): Submit a prayer request and join the prayer wall.
- [Prayer Groups](/groups): Join a live prayer group of ministers.
- [Prayer Room](/prayer-room): Live round-the-clock prayer sessions.
- [Prayer Points](/prayer-points): Weekly prayer points, confession and song of the week.
- [Testimonies](/testimonies): Testimonies of answered prayer.
- [Live TV](/live-tv): Live services and broadcasts.
- [Online Radio](/radio): Continuous worship, teaching and prayer audio.
- [Bookstore](/bookstore): Books and digital resources for ministers.
- [Events](/events): Upcoming conferences and gatherings.
- [Programs](/programs): Master classes, schools and ministry programmes.
- [Global Prayer Map](/global-prayer-map): Prayer coverage across nations.
- [Our Impact](/our-impact): Results and reach of the network.
- [Partner](/partner): Support the ministry as a partner.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the ISM team.
